definitions.explanation: A person who works under someone's supervision or command in an organization, workplace, or military.

examples.japanese: {部下|ぶか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{三人|さんにん}→三人：10978_sannin⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
{部下|ぶか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{見|み}ている→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: I keep a close eye on my subordinates' work.

examples.japanese: ⟦{優秀|ゆうしゅう}→優秀：03646_yuushuu⟧⟦な→な：09497_na⟧{部下|ぶか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{恵|めぐ}まれている→恵まれる：12619_megumareru⟧。
examples.english: I am blessed with excellent subordinates.

examples.japanese: {部下|ぶか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{指導|しどう}→指導：03190_shidou⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{管理職|かんりしょく}→管理職：21834_kanrishoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: Training subordinates is also an important job for managers.

examples.japanese: {部下|ぶか}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{信頼|しんらい}→信頼：03268_shinrai⟧⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{築|きず}く→築く：02046_kizuku⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{日|ひ}ごろ→日頃：07284_higoro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦コミュニケーション→コミュニケーション：08425_komyunikeeshon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: Daily communication is important for building a relationship of trust with subordinates.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY: ⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧ (section) + {下|か} (under).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧: boss, superior (the opposite)
- ⟦{後輩|こうはい}→後輩：02501_kouhai⟧: someone junior by seniority (entry year at a school or company), not by reporting line; a ⟦{後輩|こうはい}→後輩：02501_kouhai⟧ need not work under you
- ⟦{配下|はいか}→配下：14508_haika⟧: people under one's command (formal; used of armies and gangs as well as companies)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {部下|ぶか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧ (to have subordinates)
- {部下|ぶか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{育|そだ}てる→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧ (to develop subordinates)
- {部下|ぶか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{指導|しどう}→指導：03190_shidou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to supervise subordinates)
- {部下|ぶか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{任|まか}せる→任せる：02417_makaseru⟧ (to delegate to subordinates)
- {部下|ぶか}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧ (relationship with subordinates)

USAGE:
{部下|ぶか} implies a clear hierarchical relationship. In modern Japanese business culture, some companies prefer flatter terms like ⟦チームメンバー→チームメンバー：29792_chiimumenbaa⟧ or ⟦{担当者|たんとうしゃ}→担当者：09676_tantousha⟧ to promote a less hierarchical atmosphere.
